notation.ellipsis: Additional property functions may follow required distribution parameters (page268); ellipsis is not permission to reinterpret arbitrary positional numbers.
notation.square_brackets: Optional notation follows source; prose can declare optional parameters even when brackets are absent.
notation.normalized_symbols: Greek parameter letters and typography normalized to ASCII words; names and argument order retained.
notation.alternate_formulations: Selector/value parameter systems are listed even when the frozen manual does not specify a literal full call signature; such gaps remain open.

shared_rules.rule: Multiple property functions can follow required distribution arguments; property order/composition requires explicit semantic verification.
Ordinary statistics use simulation index 1 when omitted in the single-simulation context.
Dimensional contexts add structural formatting and parametric slice parameters; current ribbon selection may control omitted simulation. Exclusion-list conflict is ERR-006.
Outside behavior depends on display/base-case/lock/static properties and context. An SC deterministic nominal value is an explicit policy, not assumed PSI default equivalence.
